initial_prompt: Write a short, moody poem about rain on a window.

messages.content: Write a short, moody poem about rain on a window.

Grey ghosts weep against the glass,
Tracing paths of shattered light.
The world dissolves in liquid mass,
A drowning breath, an early night.

Cold fingers tap a hollow code,
Upon the pane, a silent scream.
While inside, time slows its load,
And life becomes a watered dream.
